Desc: Enemies in this stage cannot drop below 70% HP. You must use specific character skills to finish them.
Name: Execution-Ready State

Desc: While in Assault Mode, Watanabe's Resilient Strike can execute HP-locked enemies, earning rating bonuses.
Name: Judgment

Desc: When your rating tier is locked, you can execute enemies directly with Resilient Strike even if they aren't HP-locked. Performing a successful execution raises your rating tier.
Name: Connection Severed

Desc: After reaching SSS rating, you can execute enemies freely for a short duration.
Name: Overlimit State

Desc: In boss stages, player-triggered executions can deal a heavy blow to the boss, inflicting massive DMG.
Name: Solitary Ordeal

Desc: All damage you deal contributes to your rating. As your rating tier increases, executions can be triggered more often.
Name: Rating System

Desc: While the boss is HP-locked, Watanabe must use Phase 2 Signature to execute it.
Name: Threshold Override

Desc: After pinging a Yellow Orb, gains 3 Signal Orbs and increases slash charge speed in Ravenborn Form. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
Name: Luminous Beak

Desc: When casting a slash in Ravenborn Form, gains 1 random Signal Orb and increases DMG by 50%. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
Name: Lunar Scythe

Desc: After casting Death's Kiss, fully restores Omen Points and gains 3 random Signal Orbs.
Name: Ravendoom

Desc: At max Phantom Points, consumes them to gain max Collapse Points and 60% Signature Energy. Performing a Phase 2 Dodge in Roaming Form grants max Collapse Points, a Collapse Mark, numerous Signal Orbs, and Signature Energy.
Name: Celestial Authority

Desc: When using a Yellow Orb, gains 330 Collapse Points and increases Dimensional Collapse DMG by 500%. Stacks up to 5 times with infinite duration.
Name: Vector Collapse

Desc: When using Dimensional Collapse, there is a 40% chance to spawn Yellow Orbs. If Yellow Orbs fail to spawn, the probability doubles for the next Dimensional Collapse, and 6 Red Orbs are granted.
Name: Quantum Observation

Desc: During the Main Sequence of a tapped Signature, gains Crescent Points and 3 random Signal Orbs after casting Incipient Retribution.
Name: Revelatory Retribution

Desc: During the Finality of a pressed-and-held Signature, each Finality Orb pinged increases DMG by 50%, stacking up to 100 times with infinite duration. After exiting Finality, gains 6 Signal Orbs.
Name: Crimson Mooncrest

Desc: Gains a large amount of Crescent Points each time Signature is cast. Gains 1 random Signal Orb each time basic attack is performed.
Name: Phantom Liberation
